lines.say: Home at eight. You haven't opened the reading list once.
Placement's an hour away, so you read on the train.
Ward round runs over. Teaching gets moved. Lunch is a cereal bar.
Every gap you planned to revise in? Gone.
The list isn't too long. It just doesn't move when your day does.
Offload reschedules your week when the shift wins.
Comment placement and I'll send you the plan I'd use.
